entities.name: UniProt Q44625 HBbu
observations: The 108-aa query sequence is an exact full-length match to reviewed UniProt Q44625 from Borreliella andersonii.
Annotated as a histone-like DNA-binding protein that wraps and stabilizes DNA; reference GO terms include DNA binding, structural constituent of chromatin, and cytosol.
Sequence-derived properties: 12,741.56 Da; theoretical pI 10.236; instability index 38.012; GRAVY -0.6537; estimated charge at pH 7 is +10.676.
